rows.en: Hurry! The cyborg Hayato Ichimonji is indispensable to Operation Redir Rekcohs!
Yes, sir…
Now then, I shall explain Operation Redir Rekcohs.
"Operation Redir Rekcohs? Well then, let's hear it…"
First, we perform the modification surgery on Hayato Ichimonji and make him a cyborg: a Kamen Rider. Then we have him fight Takeshi Hongo!
"What? They're making a Kamen Rider!?"

Once Hayato Ichimonji defeats him, Takeshi Hongo will undergo brain modification surgery at our Shocker and become completely ours!

With that nuisance Takeshi Hongo gone, Japan will belong to our Shocker… That is Operation Redir Rekcohs.
But Takeshi Hongo has allies… And what will you do if Hayato Ichimonji is defeated?
Heh heh heh… Our Shocker science group is excellent! Such a thing would never…

…!?

Hey, you! You're a combatant, so why are you in the Operations Section?

…!?

I, uh, put on the wrong outfit…
You're slacking, you! I told you I would not tolerate slackness! Take off that mask!
Damn…
I didn't realize you even changed uniforms by department!
You're Taki!? Grr… Seize this FBI dog!
Ugh… Damn it, let go of me!!
Heh heh heh… You'll be the first to die! Do it!!

Wait!

We can kill him anytime… More importantly, use that man as bait to lure out Takeshi Hongo, Kamen Rider!
An excellent idea, Leader…
Damn it… let go! What are you planning to do with me?
We'll make you a cyborg sworn in loyalty to Shocker!! Ha ha ha…
What!? Don't screw with me! I'd never become a cyborg!

It seems you still… don't understand your position.

Either way, you're bait that will be disposed of. Once this man's brain modification surgery is done, we'll give you plenty of attention. Ha ha ha…
Ngh…
Begin the brain modification surgery!
Ugh…

Name: Hayato Ichimonji. Special skills: excels at every sport, notably 6th-dan judo and 5th-dan karate…

We'll remake this man as a cyborg and have him fight Kamen Rider!
Whoa… Stop it!!
Hold it!!

…!?

Rider! Ngh… Now's my chance!

Gwah…

You, wait! Hey, the prisoner's escaped!

…!?

Taki!? Are you all right!?
Rider, save him! Shocker means to modify him and make another Kamen Rider!
What!?
Hey, report to Colonel Zol!
Tooh!!
Gwah!
Are you all right? Hey, you!!
Are you… Kamen… Rider?
Now, hurry and get out of here! Taki, take care of him!

Wait!

As for this body of mine that's been made into a cyborg, I'm already resigned to it…

I was modified to defeat you, and you're the one who rescued me. Now I'm a Kamen Rider myself… Those Shocker guys must be sorely disappointed!

Kamen Rider!

As long as Colonel Zol is around… no, as long as Shocker is out to conquer the world, I'll fight!

I can't forgive it… Shocker, modifying humans to suit their own ends! I went through the same thing myself!

I escaped just before brain modification too… I'm glad I could stop your surgery as well!
I'm Hayato Ichimonji… Call me Hayato!
All right, Hayato… no, Kamen Rider 2! I'm Takeshi Hongo, a student at Jonan University.
Kamen Rider 2? Which makes you Rider 1…

You two… this is no time for a leisurely chat, you know?

Colonel Zol abandoned the base and fled. And Scorpion Man's outside! What'll you do? Rider… uh, 1, and you'd be 2, right?
Yeah… I'll show you right now! My true power… Henshin!

Kamen Rider!! I will have my revenge for this without fail!

As long as I, Colonel Zol, am here, it won't be long before all of Japan is placed under Shocker's rule! Go, Scorpion Man…
Wh-what!? Two Kamen Riders? Grr… Attack!!

Curse yooou!

I'll pay you back for this, I swear it!! Remember that!! Shhh, shhh, shhh, shhh!
Ah, Mr. Tachibana!
Oh, [HERO4]… Is [HERO2] all right too?
Oyassan…
And what about Takeshi?
He went off with the other Kamen Rider…
What? That Takeshi… He didn't even introduce me!
But… they're both so admirable. They're fighting for others, even at the cost of their own lives.

That's right…

If everyone only thinks of themselves, the world will never truly become peaceful and happy… That's what we're fighting for.
We're freeloaders here, after all… We've gotta work twice as hard as anyone! Right, [HERO4]?
Ah… yes!
Huh? Mr. Tachibana!
Oh, [HERO4]… Is [HERO2] all right too?
He went off with the other Kamen Rider…
But… they're both so admirable. They're fighting for others, even at the cost of their own lives.
Hey… we're fighting too, you know? Right, [HERO4]?

Yeah… supposedly!

But… what really counts is what's inside, you know? Inside!
What's that supposed to mean? You make it sound like… I'm no use at all.
That's not true… You're admirable too, [HERO2]. I know that better than anyone.
Come to think of it… what on earth did "Redir Rekcohs" mean?

What!? You still haven't figured it out?

Try reading it backwards. Shocker was building a Rider! "Redir Rekcohs" is "Shocker Rider." That's what it meant, Oyassan…

Well, let's head back…
Okaaay…

Backwards, he says… Well? That makes it "Shockerrider," right?

Ah… I see! Now I get it!

"Shock 'er, rid 'er"…
Colonel Zol's scheme ended in failure, and a dependable comrade, Kamen Rider 2, Hayato Ichimonji, joined them. But there is no rest for our heroes…
Already, a new seed of evil was about to awaken where they could not see it…
Defeat Executive Monster Scorpion Man and all Shocker Combatants!
<c3>Goro Watari</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Goro Watari</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
Emperor Banba, leader of the psychic mutant Neo-Humans, called his domain the Neo-Human Empire and sought to destroy inferior humanity and build a world of Neo-Humans alone.

U00577: [ja] read as uniforms differing by department
U00586: 十分にかわいがってやる rendered with the ironic 'give you plenty of attention' (threat of torment)
